lexicon.citation: Mohammad, S. M. (2025). NRC VAD Lexicon v2: Norms for Valence, Arousal, and Dominance for over 55k English Terms. arXiv:2503.23547. See also Mohammad (2018), ACL.

scale: All dimensions rescaled to [0,1]; v2.1 native [-1,1] maps to (score+1)/2.
matching: Exact existing ASCII/apostrophe tokenizer; no stemming, lemmatization or synonyms.
phrases: Longest nonoverlapping match within lines/sections/strong punctuation; one vote per matched term, no double-counted component words.
polar: Filter valence by absolute native score >=0.167 or >=0.333; never tune to trend.
uncertainty: 1000 song bootstrap replicates within each year; intervals do not handle serial/artist dependence. Rank-test p-values are exploratory and unadjusted.
interpretation: VAD are word/phrase norms, not validated song mood, sadness, or listener emotion. Arousal and dominance are separate dimensions, not added to a sadness index.

valence.note: Exploratory association, not causal. Year clustering does not correct serial or artist dependence.

arousal.note: Exploratory association, not causal. Year clustering does not correct serial or artist dependence.

dominance.note: Exploratory association, not causal. Year clustering does not correct serial or artist dependence.
